gfx_report.limitations: Only four fixed512pxcontexts from one real scene, independent ISO100 reference not GT. No full102MP output, seams, GPU numerics, speed benchmark, broad quality ranking or promotion.

result.scope: Engineering preflight, not full427, paired-development quality review, CUDA numerics/speed or a promoted model. Native images still require manual review before publication.

tests.GPU_execution_for_this_reference: Not performed; owned V58 workflow remains active.

native_visual_review.finding: Sky becomes uniform; truss fine structure stays soft. Foliage retains varying edge detail but remains softer than the separate ISO100 reference. Fence mesh has more grain and less regular wires than V43, while RawNIND's repeated pattern is blurred. No broad winner or promotion from this one scene.

limitations: The synthetic2-source/all28-condition and selected2-paired-crop runs exercise evaluator plumbing; they are not full427 or complete paired quality panels. GFX uses only four512pxcontexts and an independent ISO100 exposure, not GT, with no reference fit/score or 102MP output. GPU kernels/default-stream agreement, full quality and speed remain unverified.
